holdout: Column XI of the Liber Linteus Zagrabiensis
holdout_rule: Predictions below were made without Column XI. The manifest must be committed BEFORE any Column XI recovery or inspection. Predictions are not alterable after XI exposure. XI is the holdout test set for the internal predictions.
note: Internal predictions P-1..P-5 test against Column XI; external predictions P-6..P-8 test against other Etruscan witnesses. All discovery data are from D0 (raw OCR) / D1 (skeleton) layers only; no D2 inferential statistics were used. Absence of XI content is a SOURCE GAP, not a failure, for predictions whose precondition (XI contains the relevant carrier) is unmet — but P-1/P-2 preconditions are structural (XI exists as a column), so absence of the carrier IS the outcome.
